title: Google Software Engineer
description: A representative Google SWE interview loop with independent technical and Googleyness rounds.
sources_note: Representative structure based on publicly described Google interview practices; actual loops vary by team, location, and level.

rounds.title: Coding Round 1
rounds.purpose: Assess algorithm selection, implementation correctness, complexity analysis, and communication.

rubric_dimensions.label: Problem solving
rubric_dimensions.description: Frames the problem and selects a sound approach.

rubric_dimensions.label: Correctness
rubric_dimensions.description: Produces correct, testable logic and handles edge cases.

rubric_dimensions.label: Complexity
rubric_dimensions.description: Explains and improves time and space complexity.

rounds.title: Coding Round 2
rounds.purpose: Assess a distinct algorithm family with emphasis on testing, edge cases, and clean abstraction.

rubric_dimensions.label: Problem solving
rubric_dimensions.description: Frames the problem and selects a sound approach.

rubric_dimensions.label: Correctness
rubric_dimensions.description: Produces correct, testable logic and handles edge cases.

rubric_dimensions.label: Complexity
rubric_dimensions.description: Explains and improves time and space complexity.

rounds.title: System Design
rounds.purpose: Assess scalable architecture, data modeling, reliability, and explicit trade-off reasoning.

rubric_dimensions.label: Requirements
rubric_dimensions.description: Clarifies scope, constraints, and success criteria.

rubric_dimensions.label: Scale and reliability
rubric_dimensions.description: Handles load, failures, consistency, and operations.

rounds.title: Googleyness and Leadership
rounds.purpose: Assess collaboration, navigating ambiguity, humility, ownership, and leadership appropriate to level.

rubric_dimensions.label: Evidence
rubric_dimensions.description: Uses specific examples and personal contributions.

rubric_dimensions.label: Navigating ambiguity
rubric_dimensions.description: Creates clarity and sound action from uncertainty.
